description: Structured anchor that ties a comment thread to a region of an entity.

members.name: Block
members.description: Creates a block anchor.

members.name: External
members.description: Creates an external anchor.

members.name: IsValid
members.description: Returns true when the anchor has enough data for its kind.

members.name: None
members.description: Creates an empty anchor.

members.name: Page
members.description: Creates a page anchor.

members.name: PageArea
members.description: Creates a page area anchor.

members.name: PagePoint
members.description: Creates a page point anchor.

members.name: Rendition
members.description: Creates a rendition anchor.

members.name: BlockId
members.description: Logical block identifier for block or text range anchors.

members.name: EndInlineIndex
members.description: End inline index for text range anchors.

members.name: EndOffset
members.description: End character offset for text range anchors.

members.name: ExternalAnchorId
members.description: External anchor id from an imported or host-owned format.

members.name: Height
members.description: Normalized area height on a page, from 0 to 1.

members.name: HighlightedText
members.description: Text captured when the comment was anchored to a range.

members.name: IsOrphaned
members.description: True when the original anchor can no longer be resolved in the live entity.

members.name: Kind
members.description: Anchor kind.

members.name: Metadata
members.description: Arbitrary metadata for consumer use.

members.name: PageNumber
members.description: One-based page number for page, point, and area anchors.

members.name: RenditionAnchorId
members.description: Anchor id in an immutable rendition.

members.name: StartInlineIndex
members.description: Start inline index for text range anchors.

members.name: StartOffset
members.description: Start character offset for text range anchors.

members.name: Width
members.description: Normalized area width on a page, from 0 to 1.

members.name: X
members.description: Normalized horizontal position on a page, from 0 to 1.

members.name: Y
members.description: Normalized vertical position on a page, from 0 to 1.
